description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for Didit Face Match (POST /v3/face-match/), the standalone API that compares two face images 1:1. Use when checking that a selfie matches an ID document portrait or a previously enrolled photo, verifying that two photos show the same person, or adding selfie-to-document biometric comparison. Returns a 0-100 similarity score and an Approved/Declined status against a configurable decline threshold (default 30), with optional image rotation. Does not enroll faces or run blocklist or duplicate checks.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
